LESSON 42 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
SVG vs Canvas

SVG describes vector graphics as DOM elements. Canvas exposes a drawing surface whose pixels
are rendered by scripts; drawn shapes are not individual DOM elements.
SVG එකෙ vector elements වලින් graphic එකෙ හදෙනවා. Canvas එකෙට JavaScript මගින් pixels draw කෙරනවා. SVG shape එකෙ Jවනම DOM element එකෙකේ; canvas ඇතුJළේ shape එකෙ එJහම JනJවයි.
A dashboard displays icons with SVG and a frequently redrawn chart with canvas.
Vector elements Raster drawing surface · SVG · Canvas · DOM: circle · One drawing surface

Read the diagram: SVG shapes can be selected and styled as elements. Canvas drawing is
performed through a rendering context. Both require accessibility planning; complex graphics may
need alternative text or a data table.

<svg width="100" height="100" aria-label="Green circle" role="img">
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="30" fill="green"/>
</svg>
<canvas id="c" width="100" height="100">Green square</canvas>
<script>
const ctx = document.querySelector("#c").getContext("2d");
ctx.fillStyle = "green"; ctx.fillRect(20,20,60,60);
</script>
Expected result: An SVG circle and a canvas square appear.
Interview question: Which is often suitable for scalable icons?
Answer: SVG, because its vector shapes scale without raster pixelation.
Remember: SVG = vectors; Canvas = drawing surface.
Practice: Draw a rectangle in both approaches.
